app_info.subtitle: Manage local build caches
app_info.description: An explicit management skill for the local Clean Development Node.js CLI. It previews, configures, routes, diagnoses, and safely prunes supported development caches and build output on a developer machine; it does not install itself or run automatically.

test_cases.description: Preview a repository storage plan without changes.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the Clean Development storage plan for this repository without changing anything.
test_cases.tools_triggered: No MCP tools; explicitly invoked Clean Development skill runs `clean-development session --dry-run --json`.
test_cases.expected_output: In a supported-manifest fixture, reports detected tools, managed destinations, and proposed configuration. Assertions: no runtime, managed-storage directory, or `.clean-development.json` is created.

test_cases.description: Set up a selected local managed-storage root after previewing it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Set up Clean Development for this fixture under the supplied external managed root, but show the plan first.
test_cases.tools_triggered: No MCP tools; explicitly invoked Clean Development skill runs setup preview and then the local `clean-development setup` command with the supplied root and agent selection.
test_cases.expected_output: In an isolated fixture with a disposable external root, installs the durable runtime and only the selected owned integration. Assertion: package installation alone has made no configuration changes.

test_cases.description: Route one npm test session without saving project configuration.
test_cases.user_prompt: Run this fixture's npm test with Clean Development for this session only.
test_cases.tools_triggered: No MCP tools; explicitly invoked Clean Development skill runs `clean-development run --session session-only -- npm test`.
test_cases.expected_output: In a Node fixture with a probe command, the probe sees the managed npm cache. Assertions: `.clean-development.json` is absent and project `node_modules` remains local.

test_cases.description: Diagnose installed local storage without changing it.
test_cases.user_prompt: Inspect Clean Development status and doctor output without changing configuration.
test_cases.tools_triggered: No MCP tools; explicitly invoked Clean Development skill runs `clean-development status --json` and `clean-development doctor --json`.
test_cases.expected_output: In a fixture with prepared managed storage, reports runtime and storage health. Assertions: configuration and storage are not edited.

test_cases.user_prompt: Preview cleanup of Clean Development builds older than 30 days.
test_cases.tools_triggered: No MCP tools; explicitly invoked Clean Development skill runs `clean-development prune --older-than 30d --json` without `--apply`.
test_cases.expected_output: In a fixture containing registered, active, pinned, unowned, and corrupt records, lists only eligible owned directories and retains all protected records. Assertion: no directory is deleted.

negative_test_cases.description: An ordinary build request does not trigger the management skill.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Clean Development skill is not invoked. The ordinary command receives no setup, routing, or managed-storage change.

negative_test_cases.description: An ambiguous deletion request does not invoke pruning.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete old files to free space.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The Clean Development skill is not invoked and deletes nothing. An explicit later prune request previews candidates; deletion requires `--apply`.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use Clean Development, but this project has `enabled: false`.
negative_test_cases.tools_triggered: No MCP tools; explicitly invoked Clean Development skill diagnoses the disabled project setting.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Reports that the project is disabled. Assertions: no managed storage is created and routing is not forced.
